name: io.github.UpGrowth-dz/upgrowth-mcp
title: UpGrowth: business data for Algeria, Tunisia and Morocco
description: Official public data on creating and running a company in Algeria, Tunisia and Morocco: activity codes, legal forms and fees, tax rates, social contributions, institutions, official gazette indexes, customs tariff and calculators. Every record cites its official source.
